Position of the majority of young [sex of FGD] on the ladder of power and freedom (private rating) – Now: 5 = Power and freedom to make almost all major life decisions: 0 votes; 4 = Power and freedom to make many major life decisions: 1 vote; 3 = Power and freedom to make some major life decisions: 6 votes; 2 = Only a small amount of power and freedom: 0 votes; 1 = Almost no power or freedom to make decisions: 3 votes

I believe the youth in our area we have very limited power and freedom to decide on what we want as long as we live with our parents. We cannot make decision that needs finaincial resource to accomplish for example. So we are limited and therefore we are at 2.

I am married but I still don’t have a power and the freedom to make decisions. My father gives me a land and livestock when I was married but I still can’t make a decision on it. I live under my father influence. So I feel at this stage we have very limited freedom to do what we want.

I agree with them however, as compared to girls we have more freedom and power to decide. We can go out when we want and stay wherever we like. They cannot do that. We can also decide on for example if I want to go to town I need no one’s permission unlike my sister who needs to get permission. No one may even notice that I was gone but if she does, it would be found out immediately. So I say we are at stage 4.
education is important to get knowledge and to have better job opportunity.
Educated person has better thinking and analyzing capacity. They are capable of understanding things better than those who are not educated.
Education gives you the way to the world. It is the means to survive this world. You will be wise if you are educated and be able to work.

I feel when we talk about education, we have also to understand that educated people only work on jobs they are given by others, since they are educated such people can open up their own business and become job creators.

I feel education is important as it gives a person the confidence needed to deal with a problem. I feel ashamed because I dropped out of school when my father begged me to send me to school. But now I recognize the opportunity that I was not able to take and could not get it again.
Boys grade 8 and Girls grade 7- 8
University degree because they can get job in NGOs

Parents are committed to educating girls and boys because they know the importance of education.

I say more attention and opportunity or attention s given to boys than girls. They are afraid girls would bring a child if she starts going to and forth to town and they tend to keep them at home once they finished elementary school.
They girls work in the household after school as a result they do not have time to study. When they repeat class they tend to cut hope and stop going to school.

My father forced my sister to stop going to school because my mother was pregnant and she could not work at home as she was sick all the time. When my sister complained he said, “no need to invest as you will be given to somebody who would abandon me once you are in his hand”. That statement would haunt me forever. {would you mind to tell us why?] Because, I felt it is unfair and I was trying to put myself in her shoes and I never asked her how she felt but I know she feels bad because of that.

Boys, learn to take care of the livestock, row planting, Tilling, Weeding and Harvesting for early age, because when he become the household head he has to be able to do it or give proper instruction to his wife.
Preparation of tilling materials is also something our families show us from early age. Because usually they prepare it at home than buying it from the market.

Yes, I used to dream that I would become a medical doctor. But when I was at high school, I had bad friends and I could not withstand their pressure. I wish to have a job in the wereda office but my father died when I was at grade 3 I dropped out of school and start farming I married at the age of 15 I am good on education but I end up like this [he seems sad].

For men, Improved maize seed has created a lot of advantage. It increase production and have good quality product in abundance. That means being able to feed the family and selling the rest and getting good amount of money.

Improved cows may be a lot of work when they take care of them but the milk, and dairy products are very profitable for women. Since the man will not ask her the income from the sale of dairy products, she can use it as she pleases. She cannot sale the animal she has to keep taking care of it. the decision to sale it is his if she is married. If not she may decide but has to be accompanied to the market to sale it because it taboo the women sale large livestock. People may also consider her a thief and harass her.
No they don’t have equal opportunities everybody gives priority for men.
There is high cultural influence on women that confined women at home and as a result they do not have opportunity to work with technology.

Not much have been changed, rather the one difference is with regards to haricot bean. The crop used to be considered as women’s crop because they grow it in small quantity and use it for household consumption. This time, it is well known and very much demanded and the price is high so men have started to grow it in lager quantities and therefore they sale it.
We start using technology that is the change I can see.

Yes, As part of the culture men never do anything that is related to household chores. If a man does is considered as a woman’s activity he will be in trouble [they laughed] But a woman is expected to help him at the farm.
Men never do women job but women do men job. [why?] [They all laugh out loud and started talking together]
No it is a taboo. Imagine me trying to keep the fire burning and doing “kita” [pita bread], I cannot imagine myself.

Household chores are not many and are not hard to deal with. That is why they never ask for help. As for what men do the nature of the work is such that needs power and muscle. So he has to rest when he comes home.
If she gets her husband’s acceptance she can grow but she can’t sale it if she sale they start to fight the community would not accept her.
it may be difficult for a man to sell the chickens himself. That is a taboo for a man to sell eggs or chicken.
There is no such division of land. They work together and the land belongs to the man
Women always work on their husband’s land. She is expected to work on his land if he is not around of not she has to support his on his farm.
Boys do not work on his wife’s plot. For one she does not have her own plot for two it is a taboo ti take order from his wife

yes, boys also, every single member of the household including elderly people. There is no exemption during the farming season, everybody works. However, they work on the man's land. When the boys are young enough to be a man and work by himself he will takeover the work and she will help him.

No he would not say anything, his farm is also important and he needs help with row planting and weeding. So he would not ask her not to come.

He would not ask her for less help because she has no work besides working in the vegetable garden. She stays home and the household chores are easy and they cannot take that much time so she has plenty of rest once she finished her work on the vegetable garden.

they call her a man.

They are not equal men is better than women. The only thing that makes girls equal to men is the fact that they are born human otherwise, they are less knowledgeable, and therefore have lower thinking capacity.
Women never think about the future man speaks for today and tomorrow and important for the country but women they don’t know what they are talking about.
It is a bad thing because if we say man and woman are equal they stop obeying us. The man is the pillar of the house, so she must follow his order if she resists it’s not good.
It is a bad thing if the women get equality they will claim propriety that is not good for men. These days, the court is full of such cases And I feel this is not a good trend.

How easy or difficult for Diana to purchase the plot of land without David’s support (private rating) – Rate: 1 = Very easy: 0 votes; 2 = Easy: 0 votes; 3 = Neither easy nor difficult: 4 votes; 4 = Difficult: 3 votes; 5 = Very difficult: 3 votes

I say neither easy nor difficult. Here she is bringing a good idea that would help him grow and prosper better. In any case, she needs his permission. So if he refuses she has to ask elders or his good friends to consult him and convince him. Otherwise, if she go ahead without his consent, that would still be trouble as she never have to obey him. And he would count it as disobedience.

He would never agree because he is the head of the household. She cannot make that decision by herself while living with him because she is going against his authority. If she does that she will face problem. She would not even dare bite what she would not swallow. So she better abandon her idea.
